simple.summary: סְתָו (çᵉthâv) means winter (as the dark season) First listed occurrence: Song 2 11.

definitions.full: H5638. sethav סתו Kt, סְתָיו Qr noun masculine winter (loan-word from Aramaic; compare Syriac , סִיתְוָא ᵑ7 ; Arabic Lane 1504 ; probably originally ׳שׂ , compare Schw Idioticon 64 ; on ו as old nominative ending ( ׳ס for šutayu ) compare Lag BN 190 Anm .); — עָבָ֑ר הַסְּתָ֯ו Song 2:11 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to hide ;
